text:
elaine: Quick thread — weekend newsletter + post-webinar nurture plan. Need final segment defs, 3-email drip copy owners, and a split test for subject lines. Can we lock by EOD?
sam: +1. I can own the subject line A/B and tracking.
maria: I can draft the drip emails (welcome, follow-up with benchmark highlights, CTA to demo). Will post copy by 3pm.
kev: For segmentation I propose: 1) Attended webinar; 2) Registered but no-show; 3) Downloaded benchmark but not registered; 4) Cold inbound list. Thoughts?
elaine: love that. Keep the messaging tiers: high intent (attended/downloaded) = product-first, mid intent (registered no-show) = value+social proof, cold = educational + invite.
maria: I'll write variations for those tones. Suggest cadence: Day 0 (launch email), Day 3 (benchmark highlights), Day 7 (case study + CTA).
sam: For subject lines split test ideas: A) "How Redwood cut inference cost 3x — benchmark inside" B) "New benchmark: inference cost & latency you can actually ship with". Any other contenders?
kev: Shorter one: "Cut inference cost 3x — see the numbers" — might perform better on mobile.
elaine: Good. Let's do a 3-way: A/B/C where C is Kev's shorter subject. 33% traffic each for treated segments (attended/registered). For cold, send single best performer later.
maria: Quick note on CTAs: attended -> "Schedule a dedicated run"; registered-no-show -> "Watch the recording + quick consult"; cold -> "Read the benchmark".
sam: I'll set tracking UTM params: utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=webinar_launch_031_26. Will create tags in Amplitude and Marketo.
elaine: Who can QA the HTML for Gmail render? kev?
kev: I can QA and check Litmus tomorrow morning.
growth-bot: Reminder: send window availability check — recommended send times: Sat 10am PT or Mon 9am PT based on past newsletter data (open rates +12% on weekends for dev audience).
aelaine: (typo) meant @elaine: let's avoid weekend sends for enterprise lists. For dev-heavy list we can do Sat. Split by segment type?
elaine: Action items: Maria (copy + variants) by 3pm, Sam (set up A/B in SFMC + UTMs) by 5pm, Kev (QA + Litmus) tomorrow 9am, Elaine (final segment confirmation + send window) by EOD. I'll follow up in #marketing-ops once queued. :thumbsup:
maria: Got it, will ping when drafts are up.
sam: I'll create the A/B test and share the test IDs.
kev: Will run an inbox check and report issues.
elaine: Thanks team — let's aim to launch Monday if QA looks good.
